corrections.why: Idaho Fire Lookouts (August 2023) reports cement footings and other ruins and debris still on the site; 'ruins' describes footings or remains only

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts says a 35-foot L-6 tower was built in 1934; firelookout.com says one may have been added. Recorded as disputed, and the story reports both versions without choosing.

notes_for_editor: The brief's status 'gone' is corrected to 'ruins' because the Idaho Fire Lookouts post describes footings and debris on the site. That 2023 post is the only source for the current state of the site and for the road being passable only on foot, so it may be out of date. The 1934 L-6 tower is disputed and is reported as disputed. Section numbers differ: the Clearwater County list gives 38N-12E-05 and the 2016 Forest Service list gives Sec38N R12E 12; the story does not use section numbers. height_m is a conversion of the 35-foot platform figure. No staffing or fire history was found, so those are omitted. No source says whether the site is open to the public, so facts.access is omitted.
